title: Comment on “Comparison of optical properties and color stability of 3-dimensional (3D) printed shape memory and thermoformed clear aligners: A single-center, prospective clinical trial study”
html: We read with great interest the article titled “Comparison of optical properties and color stability of 3-dimensional (3D) printed shape memory and thermoformed clear aligners: A single-center, prospective clinical trial study” by Lego et al.1 The study addresses a clinically relevant topic, particularly with the increasing interest in directly 3-dimensional−printed aligners. We appreciate the authors’ contribution to this evolving field. We would like to seek clarification regarding a few methodological and interpretive aspects of the study.
